name: Modigt på Svenska
source:
Modigt på Svenska - The coastal trip consists of two memorable adventures during which you can challenge and practice your skills in Swedish!

In the first of them, Minttu, who is taking a summer vacation, runs away from a busy summer cottage on an old moped she's renovated and adventures along the west coast of Finland without any bigger plans. On the trip, however, Minttu encounters the most interesting Swedish-speaking people with whom she ends up having fun conversations and adventures on the west coast!

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.psyongames.swedish1&hl=en_US&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]

The game is designed for Finnish speakers who want to practice basic Swedish skills.
translation:
Modigt på Svenska - 沿海之旅由两次难忘的冒险组成，在此期间你可以挑战和练习你的瑞典语技能！

第一个故事中，正在度暑假的明图骑着一辆她翻新的旧轻便摩托车逃离繁忙的避暑别墅，沿着芬兰西海岸冒险，没有任何更大的计划。然而，在旅途中，明图遇到了最有趣的瑞典语人士，最终她与他们在西海岸进行了有趣的对话和冒险！

[编辑自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.psyongames.swedish1&hl=en_US&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]

该游戏专为想要练习基本瑞典语技能的芬兰语使用者而设计。
